notes: Korean reads an established acronym as a word and spells every other uppercase run letter by letter; which applies is lexical knowledge, not spelling (CEO and OPEC share their shape). These are the word-read acronyms the runtime was missing, so FIFA came out as 에프아이에프에이. Authored 2026-09-25 from the standard Korean loanword spelling; not independently verified and no synthesized audio.
